segments.en: Hello English learners and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 各位英语学习者，大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: And Amira and I are here today with a great, great lesson for you.
segments.zh: 今天，Amira 和我为大家带来一节非常精彩的课。

segments.en: Today we're going to be talking about a restaurant.
segments.zh: 今天我们要聊一个发生在餐厅里的场景。

segments.en: Amira, why don't you give us a little bit more details?
segments.zh: Amira，你来给大家多介绍一点吧？

segments.en: Well, we're talking about a situation in a restaurant and two people are involved, the waiter and the customer.
segments.zh: 我们要讲的是餐厅里发生的一件事，涉及两个人：服务员和顾客。

segments.en: And I don't want to say any more.
Let's just listen to this dialogue and we'll be back later to explain it.
segments.zh: 我们先听这段对话，稍后再回来讲解。

segments.en: I'll be your waiter for tonight.
No, I'm still working on it.
This menu is not even in English.
segments.zh: 这份菜单居然连英文都没有。

segments.en: For you, sir, I would recommend spaghetti and meatballs.
segments.zh: 先生，我推荐您点肉丸意大利面。

segments.en: Does it come with coke and fries?
It comes with either soup or salad and a complimentary glass of wine, sir.
segments.zh: 先生，这道菜配有汤或沙拉，二选一，还免费赠送一杯葡萄酒。

segments.en: I'll go with the spaghetti and meatballs, salad and the wine.
segments.zh: 那我就要肉丸意大利面、沙拉和葡萄酒。

segments.en: Your order will be ready soon.
I'll go grab a burger across the street.
segments.zh: 我还是去街对面买个汉堡吧。

segments.en: He is really angry at this customer and I can't blame him.
segments.zh: 他对这位顾客很生气，这也不能怪他。

segments.en: So, I think, Marco, you have chosen some interesting expressions for us here.
segments.zh: Marco，我想你给大家挑选了一些很有意思的表达。

segments.en: Well, the first one is I'm still working on it.
segments.zh: 第一个表达是“I'm still working on it”，意思是“我还在弄，还没完成”。

segments.en: Why don't we listen to some other examples on how you can use this word and then we'll come back and explain it.
segments.zh: 我们再听几个例子，看看这个表达怎么用，然后回来讲解。

segments.en: Did you finish reading the magazine?
Ah, so you could say I'm still working on it means I still need more time.
segments.zh: 所以，“I'm still working on it”也可以理解为“我还需要一点时间”。

segments.en: I have another one for you guys.
segments.zh: 我这儿还有一个要给大家。

segments.en: It's a phrase commonly used and you'll hear it all the time.
segments.zh: 这是一个常用表达，你会经常听到。

segments.en: It's a short way of saying Coca-Cola and French fries.
segments.zh: 这是 Coca-Cola（可口可乐）和 French fries（炸薯条）的简略说法。

segments.en: So that's basically America's fast food.
segments.zh: 这基本上就是美国快餐的典型搭配。
那菜单上接下来还有什么？

segments.en: On the menu we have a complimentary glass of wine.
segments.zh: 菜单上写着免费赠送一杯葡萄酒。
免费赠送的一杯葡萄酒。
免费赠送的一杯葡萄酒。

segments.en: Yeah, we definitely like free things.
segments.zh: 是啊，我们都喜欢免费的东西。

segments.en: Well, I have another one for us here, another interesting phrase.
segments.zh: 我这里还有一个很有意思的表达。

segments.en: So basically it's another way of saying I'm choosing.
segments.zh: 所以，它基本上就是“我选择……”的另一种说法。

segments.en: Yeah, I'll choose or I'll take.
segments.zh: 对，就是 I'll choose，也可以说 I'll take。

segments.en: Alright, the next word that I want to take a look at is grab.
segments.zh: 好，接下来我们看看 grab 这个词。

segments.en: OK, now let's listen to some other examples of how we could use grab in different situations and then we'll come back and explain it.
segments.zh: 好，我们再听几个例子，看看 grab 在不同情境下怎么用，然后回来讲解。

segments.en: On your way home, can you grab some milk?
segments.zh: 你回家的路上能顺便买点牛奶吗？

segments.en: I need to grab my coat.
Let's grab a cup of coffee.
All right, well, I would understand that go grab means go get quickly.
segments.zh: 我理解 go grab 就是“赶快去拿或买”的意思。

segments.en: So now it's time to listen one more time to the dialogue and listen carefully and try to understand why the waiter doesn't like the customer.
segments.zh: 现在再听一遍对话，仔细听，试着弄明白服务员为什么不喜欢这位顾客。

segments.en: I'll be your waiter for tonight.
No, I'm still working on it.
This menu is not even in English.
segments.zh: 这份菜单居然连英文都没有。

segments.en: For you, sir, I would recommend spaghetti and meatballs.
segments.zh: 先生，我推荐您点肉丸意大利面。

segments.en: Does it come with Coke and fries?
It comes with either soup or salad and a complimentary glass of wine, sir.
segments.zh: 先生，这道菜配有汤或沙拉，二选一，还免费赠送一杯葡萄酒。

segments.en: I'll go with the spaghetti and meatballs, salad and the wine.
segments.zh: 那我就要肉丸意大利面、沙拉和葡萄酒。

segments.en: Your order will be ready soon.
I'll just go grab a burger across the street.
segments.zh: 我还是去街对面买个汉堡吧。

segments.en: Marco, why did this waiter get angry at the customer?
segments.zh: Marco，服务员为什么生这位顾客的气？

segments.en: Well, he basically wasted the waiter's time.
segments.zh: 因为这位顾客基本上是在浪费服务员的时间。

segments.en: I mean, this guy comes into the restaurant.
segments.zh: 你想想，这个人走进餐厅。

segments.en: He is not very polite and he's asking all these questions.
segments.zh: 他不怎么有礼貌，还问了一大堆问题。

segments.en: In the end, he just gets up and says, I'll just go grab a burger across the street.
segments.zh: 结果最后他站起来说：“我还是去街对面买个汉堡吧。”

segments.en: Yeah, and I also think that this guy was a lot more casual than the place he was in, right?
segments.zh: 是啊，而且我觉得这个人的做派比他所在的餐厅随便多了，对吧？

segments.en: I think this was a nice, fancy restaurant.
segments.zh: 我觉得那是一家很不错的高档餐厅。

segments.en: So I think he was in the wrong place.
segments.zh: 所以我觉得他来错地方了。

segments.en: So how many times, Marco, tell me, do you really have fast food a week?
segments.zh: Marco，告诉我，你一周到底吃几次快餐？

segments.en: Fast food, let's see, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday.
segments.zh: 快餐啊，让我想想，周一、周二、周三……

segments.en: I think I get fast food maybe once a week, once or twice a week.
segments.zh: 我想我大概一周吃一次，或者一到两次快餐。

segments.en: All right, talking about fast food made me hungry.
segments.zh: 好了，聊快餐把我都说饿了。

segments.en: So I think I'm going to go grab something to eat myself.
segments.zh: 所以我想去买点东西吃。

segments.en: I hope you guys enjoyed the lesson today and remember that all of this vocabulary is useful for your everyday needs.
segments.zh: 希望大家喜欢今天的课，也别忘了，这些词汇在日常生活中都用得上。

segments.en: Well, actually here in EnglishPod, we focus on phrases and words that are high frequency and that means that you can use them every day in your practical life.
segments.zh: EnglishPod 着重讲解高频词汇和短语，也就是你每天在实际生活中都能用到的表达。

segments.en: And be sure to go to our website at EnglishPod.com where you can find many other resources and you can leave your questions and comments at our community forum.
segments.zh: 记得访问 EnglishPod.com，那里有更多学习资源，你也可以在社区论坛留言提问、发表意见。

segments.en: So thank you very much for listening.
segments.zh: 所以非常感谢你的收听。

segments.en: We'll be back tomorrow with another great lesson for you.
segments.zh: 明天我们会再为大家带来一节精彩的课。
